1879205900.name: Heartmender's Raiments
1879205900.desc: This fine armour was worn by the most talented Arnorian bards. The songs of these gifted few were filled with beauty and strength in equal measures, the melodies of which could be heard often within the City of Kings.

1879205901.name: Raiments of Vicious Proclamation

1879205902.name: Armour of the Oathesworn
1879205902.desc: This fine armour was worn by the most dedicated Arnorian sentries. Tales tell of the oathes sworn on the shores of Evendim by these elite protectors of the City of Kings.
